description: createVersionDynamicRouting response drift: the docs describe the result as the created version ({id, created_at, elements, ...}) but the live API's result is route metadata carrying the new version's id as a top-level `version_id` (plus resource_id etc.). Add the member so callers can deploy the version they just created.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Identifier of the newly created version (top-level on the live wire; the docs' nested shape is stale).
